scope: New ground hazard illustration only; existing creature images unchanged.
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent game ground-effect animation atlas, exactly 4 columns by 2 rows, eight isolated square cells, no captions or lines. Primary request: hand-painted medieval infernal fresco pigments for SIGIL BREACH; the game feels like walking inside aged Giovanni da Modena Inferno and Michelangelo Last Judgment frescoes. These are ground decals seen STRAIGHT DOWN orthographically, NOT perspective views, NOT floating platforms. Every cell contains the same centered roughly circular 80%-cell-width footprint with a clear 10% transparent gutter on all sides. Top row: ash lord scorched earth in four animation states: 1 low charred branching cracks with ochre/rust embers, 2 and 3 an active scorched stain of matte charcoal and russet with curling hand-painted ochre flame tongues INSIDE its round footprint, 4 dying ashen fragments and dim embers at same footprint. Bottom row: plague stain in four matching states: 1 irregular thin umber ochre tarnished-olive seepage, 2 and 3 active viscous poison with small crooked hand-painted ochre bubbles and blackened fungal branching, 4 drying muted olive ash fragments at same footprint. Design ground patches as fragmented pigmented shapes with visibly transparent gaps; retain the floor through gaps. No solid circular disks, no dark filled background, no 3D crater holes or hard extruded rims. Keep a visibly legible irregular boundary at the same radius in all states, but NO geometric bright outline. Style is genuine matte antique mural illustration: broad irregular brush masses, economical low resolution detail, aged earth pigment, no photographic scratches, no clean vector outlines, no glossy game VFX, no neon, no bloom, no photorealistic smoke. Flat painted forms with restrained warm highlights; subtle parchment-like material WITHIN marks only, never opaque paper backing. True alpha transparency outside every individual isolated mark and inside gaps. All eight cells independent, no overlap, generous clean gutters; same scale and center; no creatures, weapons, text, labels, GUI, watermarks. Landscape sheet 2:1 aspect ratio.
processing: Copied original alpha PNG unchanged. UV registration and circle clipping are presentation geometry, not damage geometry.
historicalNote: Original painted scorch and poison marks; they are not claimed to reproduce a historical Goetic seal.
